notes.author: pete
notes.text: Bob and Lorraine are hosting the grief and loss group in their home this season. They lead from their own experience with Jenny, and they do it gently.

replies.author: ted
replies.text: Two people from the care list asked about it. I'll send them Bob's way.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Coffee with Lorraine. She said leading the grief group has been healing and hard at the same time. Encouraged her to take a week off when she needs it, and offered to cover a night.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Lorraine's daughter, Jenny, went to be with the Lord yesterday. Remember to be gentle with Lorraine around this time each year.
notes.testPurpose: A legacy alert note from Rock's original sample data that her bio refers to.
